// diagnostic

E0734

tag `{tag}` has an incomplete policy body.

What

tag `{tag}` has an incomplete policy body.

Why

Every tag declares an enforceable policy with a required non-empty `deny` list and optional `from` list.

Fix

Write `tag {tag} { deny: [Effect], from: [source.path] }`; omit `from` when it is not needed.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0734: tests/ui/tag_missing_policy.stderr.

Error [E0734]: tag `Risk` needs a policy body
  --> tests/ui/tag_missing_policy.jet:1:5
    |
  1 | tag Risk
    |     ^^^^
 Why: a tag declares a dataflow fact, including where that fact is denied
 Fix: write `tag Risk { deny: [Effect] }`
